program.name: Bell Legs Long
program.subject: Legs & glutes
program.blurb: Long leg days with one kettlebell: squats and lunges, swings and single-leg deadlifts.
program.about: Legs built with one kettlebell and plenty of time. One day is goblet and front squats with reverse lunges, the next swings, suitcase deadlifts and single-leg deadlifts, then an upper day with the same bell. Straight sets throughout. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
program.split: Goblet & lunge / swing & single-leg deadlift / bell upper
